The family's own artifacts disagree on the route key, and the key the participant-facing pages print does not exist. production-field-map.json, participant-instructions.md and the Route: line printed on the pages of both fixtures carry "obligation:track-pathway:KY:ky_void_seal_controlled_substance:void-and-seal", while product-wiring.json and the MASTER_QUEUE row carry "obligation:track-only:KY:ky_void_seal_controlled_substance". The canonical route universe (data/rcap-grade-a/route-obligation-census-candidate/canonical-route-universe.json) contains only the track-only key; the track-pathway:...:void-and-seal key occurs zero times there. The statute, jurisdiction and track id all agree, so this is a keying defect, not a wrong-route packet - but a Grade-A record must be keyed to an exact route, and the face and field map are keyed to a route that does not exist. Repair: re-key production-field-map.json and participant-instructions.md to the canonical track-only key and rerender so the printed Route: line matches; every other one of this verifier's obligations passes on the current bytes.

evidence.comparison: the other ten families in this verifier two lanes all agree fieldMap = wiring = MASTER_QUEUE; only these two Kentucky families disagree

failedObligations.finding: One mapped known prefill is absent from the boundary artifact's bytes. participant.email is mapped to 200-00132 page 1 field "34i" (rect x395.69 y120.55 w174.74 h12.96) in both fixtures. The canonical artifact carries it: packet page 3 holds eight flattened widget appearances, the eighth reading "jordan.reyes@example.org". The boundary artifact carries only seven on the same page and the email is not among them, while the family's own report still records valuesReportedByFinalizer 8 for that document and fixture. The loss is silent — no refusal, no unfittable note, no finding. It is not a policy on long values either: the same boundary email, maria.alejandra.oshaughnessy.whitfield@longmailexample.org, is written and present on packet page 2 (200-00130) and packet page 5 (600-00228) of the same artifact.

evidence.method: Every page of both artifacts was opened and its flattened widget appearance streams decoded byte-exactly in this lane; the counts and values above are read from the PDF bytes, not from reports/actual-writes.json.
evidence.reportTranscriptionObservation: reports/actual-writes.json renders the boundary name as "Maria-Alejandra OShaughnessy-Whitfield", dropping the apostrophe. The bytes are correct: the appearance stream carries 0x92 (WinAnsi right single quotation mark) between O and S. The dropped character is a defect in the report's read-back transcription, not in the artifact, and no obligation is failed on it.
